The image displays a geometric pattern composed of green triangles arranged in a tessellated, mountain-like formation against a white background. The design features a series of peaks and valleys, with the highest point located near the center-right of the image. The triangles vary in shade from light mint green to dark forest green, creating a sense of depth and contour. The pattern is symmetrical along a vertical axis, with the central peak being the tallest and widest, flanked by progressively smaller peaks on either side. The overall shape resembles a stylized mountain range or a digital representation of a terrain elevation map.

The image displays a graphic logo consisting of the text "CLASS 8" set against a white background. The text "CLASS" is written in a bold, black, sans-serif font. The number "8" is significantly larger than the text, rendered in a light grey color with a subtle gradient or shadow effect that gives it a slight three-dimensional appearance. To the bottom right of the number "8", there is a decorative element made of three green triangles arranged in a staggered, upward-pointing formation.
